notes.title: 🚀 Sneak Peek: What’s Coming in Dream World’s Next Update!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Dream World adventurers! 🌟[/b]

Our next big update is just around the corner, and while we’re still making final adjustments, we wanted to give you a glimpse of what’s coming. This isn’t the full patch list—expect official patch notes closer to launch—but here are some key highlights to get excited about!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/db49e73e9f3c4cf8b0bb15d1dfd53e4e00aa6975.png[/img]

[b]🔥 What’s in Development?[/b]
🏹 Mob Refactor – Smarter Enemies & Better Combat
We’re continuing to refine enemy behavior, making combat more dynamic, responsive, and strategic.

✅ Improved combat logic – Enemies will move and attack more intelligently.
✅ Better world destruction mechanics – Environments react more realistically during battles.
✅ Multiplayer replication improvements – Smoother AI behavior in co-op play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/0cab4b469e3f56368d3858c58abb577e635d8eba.png[/img]

[b]🎮 Confirmed: Full Controller Support![/b]
We’re happy to confirm that full controller support is coming in this update! Gamepad players will enjoy seamless input, improved UI navigation, and better responsiveness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/26090dcb527808757fc75c947d36ab9b2b528731.gif[/img]

[b]🏙 Performance Optimizations & Area Protection Fixes[/b]
This update also includes major performance improvements, especially for large cities and multiplayer environments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126151/541066b5a192edd3b928eba06b079b7e0b7ebb88.png[/img]

✅ City performance optimizations – Faster load times & improved FPS.
✅ Area Protector System Fixes – Bug fixes and general stability improvements.
✅ Secondary Drop System Tweaks – More balanced and dynamic loot distribution.

📌 Until then, make sure to [b]follow and wishlist DreamWorld [/b]so you don’t miss anything!

notes.title: DreamWorld Referral Program – Invite Friends & Earn Rewards! 🎁
notes.content:
Dear Dreamers!

We’re thrilled to introduce the [url=https://gleam.io/gvhxH/refer-a-friend]DreamWorld Referral Program[/url], where you can earn rewards by inviting friends to play DreamWorld! 

[h3][b]Here’s how it works:[/b][/h3]

[olist]
[*] [url=https://gleam.io/gvhxH/refer-a-friend][b]Sign up on Gleam[/b][/url]
Visit our Gleam page here and sign up using your email. Connect your Steam account to activate the referral tracking system.
[*] [b]Play DreamWorld on Steam:[/b]
If you haven’t already, request access to play DreamWorld on Steam and dive into the infinite world of adventure. This step is required to unlock your referral link.
[*] [b]Generate Your Referral Link:[/b]
Once you’ve connected your Steam account, click on the “Refer Friends” button on the Gleam page. You’ll receive a unique referral link that you can start sharing immediately.
[*] [b]Share Your Link Everywhere:[/b]
Post your link on social media, share it in gaming groups, or send it directly to friends. The more you share, the more chances you have to earn points!
[*] [b]Earn Points for Successful Referrals:[/b]
For every friend who signs up using your link and plays at least once, you’ll earn +10 points. Remember, your friend must play at least once for the referral to count.
[*] [b]Redeem Your Rewards:[/b]
For every 100 points (equivalent to 10 successful referrals), you’ll receive a $10 Amazon gift card! Points are automatically tracked, and rewards are sent to the email you registered with Gleam every Friday.
[/olist]

[b]This Event runs until November 15th.[/b]

Want to learn more about how to maximize your rewards? [url=https://www.playdreamworld.com/blogpost/bbbeb6e1-d832-420f-af82-5073df9bba6d]Read the full blog post here![/url]

Every referral counts! If you have any questions, feel free to reach out on Discord or email  support@playdreamworld.com


Stay awesome, keep dreaming, and see you online! 🪐✨
